name: John Deere Waterloo Works - Engine Works - Waterloo IA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed John Deere Waterloo Works Engine Works at 3801 W Ridgeway Ave, Waterloo IA. Roster ROOFTOP coords (moved 351m) landed on the long industrial building; locked center refined to 42.4678,-92.4330.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred true, medium confidence. The whole property is clearly fenced (continuous fence line visible at z19-z20). The truck yard sits at the SE corner of the building accessed by a private driveway loop set well back from the road. Street View only reaches the surrounding public roads (W Ridgeway Ave north, side road east) and never reaches the truck-yard entrance, so a barrier arm could not be directly confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth positively identified. A small blue-roof structure at 42.4669,-92.4298 is a utility/pump building (set off in grass, away from the driveway pinch-point), not a guard shack. Set false; remoteGs set true accordingly.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True by rule — gate inferred present but no guard shack visible, implying kiosk/call-box/app check-in.
fieldNotes.mainEntrance: Primary W Ridgeway Ave entrance is an open driveway leading to a circular visitor drive (flagpole) and employee parking — the office/visitor entrance, no gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~16 dock doors along the south building face; several blue/teal/green trailers backed in (z20 at 42.4678,-92.4318). Approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a small number of trailers (~10-15) in the SE yard plus container/material-storage racks; band 0-10 for unaccompanied drop trailers, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated multi-row trailer storage lot — yard is dock staging plus material racks; set false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long private driveway loop from the road into the SE truck yard holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved aprons and the deep driveway loop give ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main engine plant building plus a small ancillary structure; 2.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~95 acres including the large open grass land south of the building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Waterloo IA with cropland to the north and west and large open grass on the property — Rural.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved yard inside the fence before the docks; inferred true, low confidence.
